[EN] The way I see it, if you're not castanic, you might as well be amani. Their word is good and they suck the marrow right out of the bones of life! So very much alike yet so different. Ask me to choose an ally not of the clan, and I'll pick an amani every time.
[ES] A mi modo de ver, si no eres castanic, bien podrías ser amani. ¡Su palabra es ley y le sacan el jugo a la vida! Tan parecidos y a la vez tan diferentes. Pídeme que elija un aliado que no sea del clan, ¡y elegiré a un amani siempre!
